description: This Java source file defines the class OpenmrsProfileIncludeFilter, which implements the Spring TypeFilter interface. Its purpose is to create beans conditionally based on the presence and attributes of the OpenmrsProfile annotation, primarily for managing bean creation depending on different OpenMRS profile versions.

classes.name: OpenmrsProfileIncludeFilter
classes.description: A filter class used within Spring's classpath scanning mechanism to determine whether a bean should be included based on OpenMRS profile annotations.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Determines if the class represented by MetadataReader matches the filter criteria based on the presence and attributes of the OpenmrsProfile annotation. Returns true if the profile matches and the bean should be created.
